# Astemes Triarc Framework

> A LabVIEW framework for applications built from concurrent processes that communicate with messages, requests and broadcasts. Installed with VIPM into <vi.lib>\Astemes\Triarc Framework\ (TF.lvlib).

Agents reading or changing code built on Triarc should start with the Agent Guide.

## Agent guide

- [Agent Guide](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/95_Agent%20Guide/Agent%20Guide/): Rules, facts, error codes and review pitfalls for agents, in one page

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/15_Getting%20Started/Getting%20Started/): Create a first application and process
- [Process](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/22_Process/Process/): Lifecycle, process loop and configuration
- [Application](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/23_Application/Application/): Composing processes, qualified names
- [View](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/24_View/View/): Processes with a front panel
- [Handling Messages](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/26_Handling%20Messages/Handling%20Messages/): Handle Messages.vi and API VIs
- [Messaging](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/27_Messaging/Messaging/): Sending messages
- [Broadcasting](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/28_Broadcasting/Broadcasting/): One-to-many events
- [Requests](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/29_Requests/Requests/): Request and response
- [Error Handling](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/30_Error%20Handling/Error%20Handling/): Error handlers and framework error codes
- [Logging](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/35_Logging/Logging/): Log handlers and levels
- [Helper Loops](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/40_Helper%20Loops/Helper%20Loops/): Periodic parallel work
- [Async Handler](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/45_Async%20Handler/Async%20Handler/): Blocking work off the process loop
- [Testing](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/60_Testing/Testing/): The Triarc test suite
- [Configuration](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/80_Configuration/Configuration/): Configuration files
- [Best Practices](https://astemes.github.io/astemes-triarc-framework/90_Best%20Practices/Best%20Practices/)
